candidates.title: 주변 수식과 다른 패턴 후보
candidates.description: 주변 반복 수식과 다른 구조를 확인한 후보입니다. 업무적으로 정상일 수 있으므로 사용자가 직접 확인해야 합니다.

formula_pattern.detection_basis: M01~M12 header-to-sheet correspondence was compared across a same-row binary subtraction run; one interior cell differed while both adjacent month cells matched the dominant sheet-reference pattern.
current_limitations: Formula results, business rules, and intentional exceptions were not evaluated.
Only explicit M01~M12 month headers with existing sheets and simple subtraction are supported.
No repair formula or automatic workbook change is generated.
formula_pattern.evidence_summary: The target formula uses a different monthly sheet-reference pattern from the surrounding M01~M12 subtraction formulas.
formula_pattern.dominant_pattern_summary: Nearby month formulas repeat the same subtraction shape against their matching M01~M12 sheets.
formula_pattern.current_pattern_summary: The target formula does not resolve to the monthly sheet that matches its header.
formula_pattern.normal_case_possibility: This can be intentional only if the workbook owner meant to break the month-header-to-sheet correspondence for this one cell.

limitations: 수식 계산 결과, 업무 규칙, 의도된 예외 계산은 확인하지 않았습니다.
지원하는 A1 참조 수식의 제한된 주변 패턴만 비교했습니다.
수정 수식 생성·적용이나 자동 수정 가능 여부는 제공하지 않습니다.
